scope: Read-only PGD artifact and selection audit; no model or gradient recomputation
limitations: PGD10 uses a fixed 2/255 step, ten updates and one clean start; no low-distortion step-size or objective search was performed.
PGD10_MATCHED matches only the stopping/selection/refinement rules. It is not a globally optimized low-distortion PGD comparator or an equal-compute latent comparison.
Bisection starts only after an observed budget- and LPIPS-qualified success; an overshooting initial 2/255 update can leave only the clean fallback even when a smaller pixel step might succeed.
Timing is the shared actual ten-step computation plus possible refinement and both exports, not an independent early-stopped runtime.

Intermediate gradient tensors and candidate pixels are not all serialized: this audit verifies frozen implementation, logged candidate rules and final saved hashes, without independent model execution.
